**Issue #4448 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4448: Patch: the AI's turn-hook and Activate shares are fork-screened at a whole use and set where the screen keeps them
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Some cards keep paying their owner every turn: a unit that deals damage at the end of each turn, a Field Spell that gives mana at the start of yours, a unit with an ability it can use every turn. The practice AI works out what one use of such a card is worth, then counts only half of it. The half was a placeholder that the AI's old self-training was meant to correct. That training no longer runs, so the half stays for good.

So an enemy card that will hit the AI every turn counts as half of one hit, and the AI can leave it standing and lose to it slowly. Its own engines are undervalued the same way, so it can trade one away too cheaply. This issue tries the whole value instead, one card kind at a time, on the new tuning test that looks only at the moves a change alters. It keeps the whole value only where that test shows the AI winning more from those moves. Practice players would meet an opponent that answers their engines sooner and protects its own. If the test shows nothing, nothing plays differently, and the measurement is recorded.

## Why

- **The half is a placeholder.** `AI_EVAL.turn_hook` and `AI_EVAL.activation` are 0.5, each "an untuned start for the training lanes" (`crates/ai/src/config.rs:750-755`; R2477000 and R2564000: "starts at 0.5, untuned").
  - Only smoke-gate counts back them, for example "At 0.5 the smoke gate read 20, 16 and 17 of 20; at 1.0, 19, 16 and 16".
  - The gates see only a broken AI (§9.9, Quality gates; `crates/ai/README.md`, Matches and the quality gates).
- **Nothing will move it now.** The learn lane is retired (R4159000, 2026-11-18) and the improve and unban lanes are stopped (#1677). `crates/ai/generation.json` has stayed at generation 13 since 2026-10-21, while more than 90 commits have touched `crates/ai`.
- **The AI's own diagnosis points here.** `training/improve.md` (The first job) names the losses it keeps tracing: "midgame snowballs: an engine, a unit that grows or makes value every turn, priced at its body today and left unanswered".
  - These two prices are where an engine's worth enters the evaluation: `unit_worth` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:713`, `735`) and a readable backrow card in `material` (`evaluate.rs:1328`, `1335`).
  - Today each counts half of one use.
- **They act in most games.** Of 800 non-token cards, 101 have text with a start- or end-of-turn effect and 89 have an Activate (`crates/cards/catalog.json`, counted 2026-11-22). A 30-card deck holds about seven of them.
- **The deal screen could not settle knobs like this.** #4246's and #4286's screens read 0 to 4 decided deals of 200 (`config.rs:1039-1052`), which R4319000 calls inconclusive. The fork screen (R4397000, #4422, landed 2026-11-22) was built for a change that acts in a few moves of a game. No knob has been screened on it yet.
- **This is not a sweep.** `training/improve.md` rules out weight sweeps, because a sweep's best arm, picked on the seeds that measured it, read lower on fresh deals. Here each knob gets one arm, chosen before any screen: 1.0, one whole use. Each is kept only on its own screen.

## Proposal

1. **Screen `turn_hook`.** Build a control from the committed tip. The candidate sets `turn_hook` to 1.0. Run one fork screen: `cargo jackioh arena --a self --b bin:<control> --set improve-dev --forks --extend`, with `--extend` decided in advance. Keep 1.0 only when `forkEdgeLow` is above 0.
2. **Screen `activation`.** Rebuild the control from the tip as step 1 left it. The candidate sets `activation` to 1.0, on the same screen and the same rule.
3. **Record each screen.** Each knob's comment records its screen as `training/improve.md` step 5 records one: its kind, trunk games, forks, live forks, `forkEdge` with its interval, the control's commit, and whether it was kept, reverted or inconclusive.
   - A value that moves gets a ruling note in the issue's block, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md`, since R2477000 and R2564000 say each starts at 0.5.
   - §9.9 names no number and stays as it is.
4. **Record the screen's time.** `training/improve.md` (A screen) records how long one fork screen took, on what machine, so later screens can be sized. None is recorded today.
5. **Pinned scenes.** A scene test that moves under a kept value is looked at. One whose rule still holds is pinned again with the reason, as R4159000 did. One the new value plays wrong leaves that knob at 0.5, whatever the screen read.

Out of scope:
- `death` (48 cards) and `attack_hook` (9 cards, too few forks to read).
- The affliction shares that R3822000 left to revisit.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/config.rs` (`AI_EVAL.turn_hook`, `AI_EVAL.activation` and their comments)
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/turn_hooks.rs`, `activations.rs`, and any pinned scene that moves
- `training/improve.md` (A screen)
- If a value moves: `spec/rulings/R<N>000.md` and `spec/pending/<N>.md`
- `crates/server/tests/fixtures/practice-claim.json`, recorded again only if the web's claim test no longer plays it move for move (`training/README.md`, What a lane may change)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Two fork screens ran, one per knob, each against a control built from the tip it was measured on, each recorded in its knob's comment.
- [ ] A knob is 1.0 only if its own screen's `forkEdgeLow` was above 0. Otherwise it is 0.5, with the screen recorded, an inconclusive one included.
- [ ] No knob was screened twice, and no knob was screened at an arm other than 1.0.
- [ ] If a value moved, a ruling note's proving test `r<N>000_…` shows a scene the new value plays differently. For example: the AI now destroys an enemy end-of-turn damage engine that at 0.5 it left standing.
- [ ] `training/improve.md` records one fork screen's wall time and the machine it ran on.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo jackioh gate`, clippy, fmt and `cargo jackioh spec check` are green. The practice-claim fixture is recorded again if the web's claim test needs it.

## Size and risks

**Small diff, long compute.** The diff is two numbers, their comments, and perhaps a ruling and some re-pinned scenes. The work is two fork screens, each unmeasured: up to 200 trunk games with the candidate asked at every decision, plus at most 400 forks of 16 rollout games. That is likely a few hours each on a runner, so the issue may take more than one bot run.

- **The tool's first real use.** The fork screen reads a gain that compounds across moves low, never high, so it errs towards keeping 0.5.
- **Wider reach.** `turn_hook` also scales a shipyard's yard price (`evaluate.rs:1157`). The screen measures the knob as a whole.
- **Nothing else moves.** Decks never read these weights, and the generation does not move, so no sweep of record starts.

## Steps

Screens are long (hours). Run each as a background command (`run_in_background: true`) that writes its output to a file in `$TMPDIR`. Poll it with short checks and never re-run it. 1. **Fix the plan before running anything.**
   - Kind of screen: fork screen with `--extend`.
   - One arm only: 1.0.
   - Order: `turn_hook` first, then `activation`.
   - Keep rule: `forkEdgeLow` > 0.
   - Do not rerun a screen, probe another arm, or extend by hand.
   - Run `date -u` and `nproc` first, to record the machine.

2. **Control 1 (the tip, both knobs at 0.5).** From the repo root:
   `cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools && cp target/release/jackioh $TMPDIR/control-turn-hook`
   Record `git rev-parse --short=10 HEAD` as the control's commit. The tree is clean, so it is `6459c02cd6`.

3. **Candidate 1.** In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, set `turn_hook: 1.0,` and leave `activation` at 0.5.

4. **Screen 1** (timed; record the start, the end and the wall minutes):
   `cargo jackioh arena --a self --b bin:$TMPDIR/control-turn-hook --set improve-dev --forks --extend > $TMPDIR/screen-turn-hook.out 2>&1`
   - Run it in the background, via `time` or `date -u` before and after.
   - Do not pass `--a-skill`.
   - Read the closing tally: `trunkGames`, `forks`, `liveForks`, `forkEdge`, `forkEdgeLow`, `forkEdgeHigh`, `inconclusive`, and any faulted-arm counts.
   - Decide: keep only if `inconclusive` is absent and `forkEdgeLow > 0`. Otherwise revert to `turn_hook: 0.5` (inconclusive and reverted both leave 0.5).

5. **Record screen 1 now,** before screen 2, so a cut-off run loses nothing. Replace the comment above `turn_hook` with its old text plus the screen, in the form `training/improve.md` step 5 gives. Use the real numbers:
   `#4448: fork screen on improve-dev (--extend), <trunkGames> trunk games, <forks> forks, <liveForks> live, edge <x> (<low> to <high>) vs control 6459c02cd6 at 1.0: <kept | reverted | inconclusive (R4397000, R4319000)>`
   - If kept, cite `R4448000` (step 8). If not, cite no new R-id.
   - The line must fit rustfmt's comment style; `cargo fmt` does not reflow comments.

6. **Control 2.** Rebuild the control from the tree as step 5 left it. That is `turn_hook` at its decided value (1.0 if kept, else 0.5), `activation` at 0.5.
   `cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools && cp target/release/jackioh $TMPDIR/control-activation`
   - Record the control's commit as `HEAD` plus a note: "with turn_hook at 1.0 (uncommitted at screen time)" if step 4 kept it.
   - The control's commit is still `6459c02cd6` plus that one-line change. Say so in the comment.

7. **Candidate 2 and screen 2.** Set `activation: 1.0,`, then run the same command against `bin:$TMPDIR/control-activation`, output to `$TMPDIR/screen-activation.out`. Apply the same keep rule: `forkEdgeLow > 0`, else restore `activation: 0.5`. Record it in `activation`'s comment as in step 5.

8. **Ruling, only for a knob kept at 1.0.**
   - `spec/rulings/R4448000.md`. Front matter: `id: R4448000`, a `title` such as "The AI counts a turn-hook share and an Activate share at a whole use (issue #4448)", `cards: "§9.9, R2477000, R2564000, R4397000, issue #4448"`, and `proven_in:` listing the one or two test files changed. Copy the format from `spec/rulings/R4397000.md`.
   - The body gives the screen numbers, names the knob(s) moved, links `[[R2477000]]` / `[[R2564000]]` (their "starts at 0.5" is superseded for that knob), and says the other knob stays at 0.5 with its screen.
   - Add `spec/pending/4448.md` with one paragraph `**[[R4448000]] … (issue #4448, 2026-11-22)**: …`, in the style of `spec/pending/4397.md`.
   - If both knobs stay 0.5, add no ruling, no pending file and no R4448000 mention anywhere (`spec check` fails on a cited id with no note).

9. **Proving test, per knob that moved.**
   - **turn_hook:** in `crates/ai/tests/ai/turn_hooks.rs`, add `fn r4448000_…`. Use the existing helpers there (`board`, `sides`, `decide`) and `AiOptions::new(create_rng(..))`. Build a scene where an enemy unit or Field Spell with an end-of-turn damage hook faces the AI, with a removal or an attack that kills it. Assert `decide` (AI_EVAL at 1.0) takes that action.
   - **activation:** the same in `crates/ai/tests/ai/activations.rs`, with an enemy unit with an Activate.
   - Show the 0.5 contrast. `evaluate::kill_worth(state, unit, &w, prices)` and `unit_worth` take an `EvalWeights`, so build `EvalWeights { turn_hook: 0.5, ..AI_EVAL }` (same pattern as `crates/ai/tests/ai/brittle.rs:23`) and assert the kill's worth is lower than at `AI_EVAL`.
   - If the contrast needs a full `decide` at 0.5 and no API takes weights, assert only the worth difference plus the `decide` result at 1.0. Say in a test comment that 0.5's result is shown by the worth.
   - Find a scene by trying cards: Jlockeed Shredder-10 (`core-013`, End of turn: 2 damage to each enemy unit and hero) is already used in `turn_hooks.rs`.

10. **Scene tests and fixtures, only if a value moved.**
    - Run `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`. For each failure, read the test's rule.
      - If the rule still holds under the new value (a pinned decision flipped, not a bug), re-pin it with a comment giving the reason, as R4159000 did, and cite `R4448000` in the test's comment.
      - If the new value plays the scene wrong, set that knob back to 0.5, whatever the screen read, and fix the comment to say it was kept at 0.5 for that scene (name the test).
    - Run `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh && pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/practice/claim.test.ts`. If it fails, record the fixture: `JACKIOH_RECORD_PRACTICE_CLAIM=1 pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/practice/claim.test.ts`, then rerun it without the variable. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-server` for the fixture.

11. **Record the time.** In `training/improve.md`, "A screen", after step 2's paragraph about 400 games taking 25 to 45 minutes (or after step 4), add a short note. It gives one fork screen's wall minutes from step 4 (and step 7's), the trunk games and forks played, and the machine (`nproc` cores, GitHub-hosted runner via `uname -sr`). Record numbers as measured. If a screen was cut off, say so, and record only what ran.

12. **Run the checks.** See Tests.

## Tests

No new test file. Changes to the knobs make existing tests move.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`. These tests read the weight, so they stay green unless a `decide`-based scene flips:
  - `turn_hooks.rs`: line ~222 `AI_EVAL.turn_hook * 10.0`, 380, 427 and 430, 472, 666.
  - `activations.rs`: lines 121, 345, 368.
  - `activate.rs`: 570-571.
  - `starship_equip.rs`: 83, 150, 201.
  - `r2477000_decide_plays_mana_well_…` is a `decide` scene that could flip.
- If a value moved, add `r4448000_…` (above). Run it with `cargo test -p jackioh-ai r4448000`.
- Commands: `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo jackioh spec check` (needed only if a ruling was added); `cargo jackioh gate` (the AI's smoke gates; if it reads a floor miss, report it by name and do not weaken a floor).

## Done when

- [ ] Control 1 was built from the tip, and screen 1 ran once on `turn_hook` 1.0 with `--forks --extend`. It is recorded in `turn_hook`'s comment with trunk games, forks, live forks, edge with interval, control commit and verdict.
- [ ] The same holds for screen 2 on `activation`, against a control built from the tree step 5 left.
- [ ] Each knob is 1.0 only with its own `forkEdgeLow` > 0 and no inconclusive flag; otherwise 0.5.
- [ ] No knob was screened twice or at another arm.
- [ ] If a value moved: `R4448000.md`, `spec/pending/4448.md` and an `r4448000_…` test showing a scene the new value plays differently.
- [ ] Pinned scenes that moved are re-pinned with the reason, or the knob is back at 0.5. The practice-claim fixture is recorded again only if the claim test needs it.
- [ ] `training/improve.md` records the fork screen's wall time and machine.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo jackioh gate`, clippy, fmt and `cargo jackioh spec check` are green.

## Risks

- **A screen cut off mid-run.** Write each screen's result into the comment as soon as it finishes (steps 5, 7). If a pass ends before a screen does, the report says exactly where to resume. Do not guess a result, and do not restart a finished screen.
- **Run time.** Each screen may take hours (200 trunk games with the candidate asked at each decision, up to 400 forks of 16 rollout games, and `--extend`). The job budget is 330 minutes and one model call is limited to 150. Always use a background command, and do not use foreground sleeps.
- **Evidence honesty.** Quote only numbers from the tally. If a screen faulted (arm counts printed), report that in the comment.
- **`turn_hook` also scales the shipyard price** (`evaluate.rs:1157`, `yard_price`). The screen measures the knob as a whole. Do not split it.
- **Purity (rule 4).** A weight constant change adds no I/O. Keep the number in `AI_EVAL` (rule 9); add no literal anywhere else.
- **Spec check.** An R-id in a comment or test name without a note fails `spec check`. Cite `R4448000` only if the note exists.
- **Control must be the tree the knob was measured on.** If screen 1 is kept, control 2 contains that kept value.

## Open questions

- None that block the work. The run's wall time may exceed one pass, which the harness already handles by continuing a cut-off run.
```
